summary: The features repository should be configured to automatically pull the latest SDK version from each language's package manager instead of using pinned/locked versions, allowing developers to get the latest updates without manual intervention.
userImpact: Developers running features tests locally will automatically use the latest SDK versions without needing to manually update version constraints.
proposedFix: Remove version pinning in lock files and package manager configurations to allow package managers to automatically fetch the latest SDK version.
keyQuote: Allow features to default to the latest SDK version, which each lang's package manager should hopefully automatically do if we remove the set version currently.
